top_signals.title: Mitsui & Co. Said to Back J-Oil Mills in Battle Over Kadoya
top_signals.summary: Kadoya Sesame Mills Inc. shareholder Mitsui & Co. has backed a proposal from J-Oil Mills Inc. to take over the Japanese sesame seed oil seller, according to people familiar with the matter, potentially strengthening the bidder’s hand in a three-way battle for control of the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: New Zealand Dollar Drops to Six-Year Low Against Greenback
top_signals.summary: The New Zealand dollar fell to a six-year low against the greenback, weighed down by a widening interest rate gap with the US and a dimmer outlook for the nation’s economy.

top_signals.title: Death penalty sought for former SDF member over 2024 Shizuoka triple murders
top_signals.summary: The defense side called for a 25-year prison sentence for the former Self-Defense Forces member, with judgment to be rendered on Dec. 4.
